title: Unit Event — With Our Wounded Hands — Episode1 Regrets

meta.Event Outline: Ena hasn't been able to reach Mizuki since the school festival. She doesn't know what the right thing to do is, but her regrets compel her to seek Mizuki out for a heart-to-heart.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The theme of this assignment is “tranquility”, but...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But there's no way I can draw that right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I've sent a ton of messages since then, but none of them have been getting marked as read...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Even when I asked Akito, he said that Mizuki hasn't been to school for a while...)

rows.Speaker: Male Student A
rows.Line: Does that mean you're also a dude?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Others at school already seem to know.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I can't tell you right now, but when I feel ready... I hope you'll be willing to hear me out...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sometimes, talking can make things worse.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (This whole time... Mizuki must've felt so scared...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (And despite that, Mizuki was willing to tell me. But then...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (What if I'd known what to say that time...?)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Because that just makes everything harder for Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I just uploaded the lyrics I was working on, but I don't think they'll affect your illustration much...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, I've already finished coloring it, so please have a look at that. I'll upload it now.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yes, I like it. Thank you both very much...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh? Yeah, sure. That's good to hear...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <In that case, I'll make some minor adjustments and export it.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <At the rate we're going, we should be able to upload our song this weekend...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It would've been nice to see this as a music video, but Amia seems very busy. We'll just have to go with a still frame this time around...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Still, it's strange to not see or hear from Amia for so long. We talk almost every day, so things feel a little emptier than usual.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I have no right talking about that in Mizuki's place...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <It sounded like you were trying to say something just now...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Anyway, let's get back to work since we have a chance to wrap things up early this time.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Then, if the lyrics seem fine to you, I'll start entering them into the video.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, go for it. They seem fine.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Is there anything else you need, K?
We have some extra time on our hands, so I can draw whatever for you.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Kanade and Mafuyu wouldn't have batted an eye if they'd been the ones to learn about Mizuki.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Nothing would have changed, just like Mizuki wanted...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (If these two were up there that time instead of me...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Would Mizuki be here talking with us now?)
